movies.title: Lovebox
movies.plot: THE LOVEBOX follows a social experiment built around a simple question: what happens when two strangers meet without seeing each other, without expectations and without anything to gain? Inside a converted horse trailer, they enter a dark, intimate space designed to make room for openness, vulnerability and genuine connection.  The journey begins at AfrikaBurn in the South African desert, where the filmmakers encounter a temporary world shaped by participation, gifting and a different way of relating to one another. From there, the LOVEBOX travels into Cape Town and other South African communities, testing whether the same kind of encounters can happen outside the festival environment.  Through a series of intimate meetings, the film explores trust, loneliness, love and the human need to be seen — and asks what might become possible when people step beyond appearances, roles and social boundaries and simply meet one another.
keywords: human connection · love · intimacy · vulnerability · strangers · social experiment · trust · communication

movies.plot: Diagnosed with Tourette Syndrome at 15, John Davidson navigates his way against the odds through troubled teenage years and into adulthood, finding inspiration in the kindness of others to discover his true purpose in life.
movies.tagline: I blink. I twitch. I jump. I click. I whistle. I shout.

movies.title: In die Sonne schauen
movies.plot: Four adolescent girls each spend their youth in the same farmhouse over the last century. Though separated by decades, resonances between their lives emerge: their desires and distress, secrets and truths, encounters with another’s gaze and defiant gaze in return.
movies.tagline: The past doesn't fade. It echoes.

movies.title: Meeting the Buddha
movies.plot: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

movies.title: Perfect Blue
movies.plot: Rising pop star Mima Kirigoe quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.
movies.tagline: "excuse me... who are you?"

movies.title: Cold War - Der Breitengrad der Liebe
movies.criticTitle: Cold War - Der Breitengrad der Liebe
sourceTitles: Cold War - Der Breitengrad der Liebe
movies.plot: A man and a woman meet in the ruins of post-war Poland. With vastly different backgrounds and temperaments, they are fatally mismatched and yet drawn to each other.

movies.title: Bitteres Fest
movies.plot: Elsa is an advertising director whose mother dies during a long December holiday. She works non-stop and, without realizing, doesn’t give herself time to mourn her mother’s absence. After a crisis, Elsa decides to travel to the island of Lanzarote accompanied by her friend Patricia, who also needs to get away from the city. The story of these characters runs parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.
movies.tagline: You’re confusing fiction with reality.

movies.title: Bernd - Operation Germanenkind
movies.plot: An in-depth look at how fascism hides behind facades of a tolerant, intellectual and open-minded society.

movies.title: That's Why the Lady Is a Champ
movies.criticTitle: That's Why the Lady Is a Champ
sourceTitles: That's Why the Lady Is a Champ
That's Why The Lady Is A Champ
movies.plot: Christy Martin never imagined life beyond her small-town roots in West Virginia—until she discovered a knack for punching people. Fueled by grit, raw determination, and an unshakable desire to win, she charges into the world of boxing under the guidance of her trainer and manager-turned-husband, Jim. But while Christy flaunts a fiery persona in the ring, her toughest battles unfold outside it—confronting family, identity, and a relationship that just might become life-or-death.
movies.tagline: What does it take to become a legend?

movies.title: Disclosure Day - Der Tag der Wahrheit
movies.criticTitle: Disclosure Day - Der Tag der Wahrheit
sourceTitles: Disclosure Day - Der Tag der Wahrheit
movies.plot: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.
movies.tagline: We deserve to know.

movies.title: Chopin - Eine Sonate in Paris
movies.plot: He is the talk of the town, the most romantic figure of decadent Parisian nights. When his lungs start bleeding, Chopin knows his days are numbered. Composing becomes his only obsession. The ticking clock rushes him to revolutionize music.

movies.title: Magical History Tour
movies.originalTitle: The Beatles: A Magical History Tour
movies.plot: This is the candid and unabridged story of the Beatles as told by the insiders who worked, recorded and toured with the group from the Hamburg days to the bitter end. Featuring a meticulously researched and a comprehensive array of inside sources, here at last is the whole uncensored story of the life and work of the Beatles.
movies.tmdbTitle: The Beatles: A Magical History Tour

movies.title: Queen Budapest

cinemas.name: UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe

20:30.cinema: UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe
UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe

movies.plot: On 27 July 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury.

movies.title: Im Reich der Sinne
movies.plot: A passionate telling of the story of Sada Abe, a woman whose affair with her master led to an obsessive and ultimately destructive sexual relationship.
movies.tmdbTitle: In the Realm of the Senses
movies.tagline: Never before had a man and a woman loved each other so intensely.

movies.title: A Poet
movies.plot: An aging poet finds purpose mentoring Yurlady, a talented teen, though exposing her to the poetry scene might be unwise. His own poetic pursuits led nowhere, leaving him a stereotypical obscure writer.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.plot: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.
movies.tagline: Evil found a way out.

movies.title: Dangerous Minds - Wilde Gedanken
movies.plot: Former Marine Louanne Johnson lands a gig teaching in a pilot program for bright but underachieving teens at a notorious inner-city high school. After having a terrible first day, she decides she must throw decorum to the wind. When Johnson returns to the classroom, she does so armed with a no-nonsense attitude informed by her military training and a fearless determination to better the lives of her students -- no matter what the cost.
movies.tagline: She broke the rules... and changed their lives.

movies.title: Don Camillo und Peppone
movies.altTitle: Le petit monde de Don Camillo
movies.plot: In a village of the Po valley where the earth is hard and life miserly, the priest and the communist mayor are always fighting to be the head of the community. If in secret, they admired and liked each other, politics still divided them as it is dividing the country. And when the mayor wants his "People's House"; the priest wants his "Garden City" for the poor. Division exist between the richest and the poorest, the pious and the atheists and even between lovers. But if the people are hard as the country, they are good in the bottom of there heart.
movies.tmdbTitle: The Little World of Don Camillo

movies.title: Junkies of Dreaming - Mahler 3 Currentzis
movies.plot: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

movies.title: Das Ende der Sterne

cinemas.name: UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe

23:00.cinema: UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe
UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe

movies.plot: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.
movies.tagline: At the end of the world, no one survives alone.

movies.title: Der Wald vor lauter Bäumen
movies.plot: As an awkward idealistic high school teacher begins her first job in the city, things turn out to be much tougher than she had imagined.

movies.title: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
movies.criticTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
sourceTitles: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour
movies.originalTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
movies.plot: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.
movies.tmdbTitle: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
movies.tagline: Billie Eilish and James Cameron reinvent the concert experience.

movies.title: Zeugin der Anklage
movies.plot: An ailing barrister is thrust back into the courtroom in what becomes one of the most unusual and eventful murder cases of the lawyer's career when he finds himself defending a man being tried for the murder of a socialite.
movies.tagline: The most electrifying entertainment of our time!

movies.title: Strange Harvest
movies.plot: Detectives are thrust into a chilling hunt for a sadistic serial killer from the past whose return marks the beginning of a new wave of grotesque, otherworldly crimes tied to a cosmic force.
movies.tagline: He isn't hiding, he's waiting.

movies.title: Heart of Light - eleven songs for Fiji
movies.criticTitle: Heart of Light - eleven songs for Fiji
sourceTitles: Heart of Light - eleven songs for Fiji
movies.originalTitle: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
movies.plot: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.
movies.tmdbTitle: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji

movies.title: Marty Supreme
movies.plot: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.
movies.tagline: Dream big.

movies.title: Frühstück bei Audrey
movies.plot: Eastern France, nowadays.  Rémi, who has never recovered from a heartbreak, shares his life with a doll called Audrey. But the day his new coworker, Patricia, arrives at his company, Audrey comes to life. The two women will turn Rémi’s life upside down.

movies.title: Moscas - Fliegen und andere Gäste
movies.plot: Olga lives a strictly regulated life without attachments in a vast apartment block. When out of financial necessity she rents a room in her apartment to a man who also sneaks-in his nine-year-old son, an unlikely bond forms. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

movies.title: Diamanti
movies.plot: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

movies.title: Hope
movies.plot: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.
movies.tagline: Is this how it ends?

movies.title: In the Mood for Love
movies.plot: In 1960s Hong Kong, two neighbors form an intimate bond after making a discovery about their spouses in this visually stunning tale of unrequited love.
movies.tagline: Feel the heat, keep the feeling burning, let the sensation explode.

movies.title: Shaun das Schaf - Spuk im Kürbisfeld
movies.criticTitle: Shaun das Schaf - Spuk im Kürbisfeld
movies.altTitle: Shaun the sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
sourceTitles: Shaun das Schaf - Spuk im Kürbisfeld
movies.originalTitle: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movies.plot: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.
movies.tmdbTitle: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movies.tagline: What's that coming over the hill?

movies.title: Oh la la 2 - Neue Tests, neues Chaos
movies.criticTitle: Oh la la 2 - Neue Tests, neues Chaos
sourceTitles: Oh la la 2 - Neue Tests, neues Chaos
movies.plot: DNA tests before Alice and François's wedding reveal their fathers - an aristocrat and car dealer - aren't as French as they thought.

movies.title: Call Me Queen
movies.plot: The film depicts a friendship between an Irish journalist in Kenya and a Rwandan woman, who pair up to combat the AIDS crisis in the 1990s.

movies.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
movies.plot: After getting a flat tire in the middle of nowhere, newly engaged couple Brad and Janet encounter the eerie mansion of the flamboyant, seductive Dr Frank-N-Furter and a variety of eccentric characters. Through elaborate dance and rock music, the mad scientist unveils his latest creation: a perfect, muscular man.
movies.tagline: A different set of jaws.

movies.title: Casablanca
movies.plot: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.
movies.tagline: They had a date with fate in Casablanca!

movies.title: Hass
movies.plot: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.
movies.tagline: How far you fall doesn't matter, it's how you land…

movies.title: Kuzma
movies.plot: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

movies.title: Etwas ganz Besonderes
movies.plot: As a contestant in a singing casting show, Lea is asked by the TV team who she is and what makes her special. She doesn't know and begins to slip into different roles in her search for what makes her special, developing an unexpected fascination for her aunt Kati. Kati's return home as head architect for the renovation of the Residenzschloss after many years abroad reunites the family in one place. This reunion raises the hopes of grandparents Friedrich and Christel that they can join forces to give their pension, which has few visitors, a new lease of life.

movies.title: Glennkill: Ein Schafskrimi
movies.plot: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.
movies.tagline: A new breed of mystery.

movies.title: Lebensansichten eines Huhns
movies.plot: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

movies.title: All my Sisters
movies.plot: Growing up in Tehran, a capital of the 21st century... From 2007 to 2025, within a loving family, eighteen years in the life of three sisters, from their early childhood to their daily lives as young women in search of freedom. Brought up in the traditional way, witnessing the struggles of a youth in perpetual movement, what is their future in today's Iranian society?

movies.title: Für immer 16
movies.plot: Charlotte, Helena, and Oskar haven't really been in touch since their experimental filmmaking group disbanded. A shared vacation aims to reunite the bitterly estranged trio, but envy and jealousy soon flare up again. Things get really complicated when Rudolph joins the group and they decide to make a film about a female serial killer.

movies.title: Ice Cream Man
movies.plot: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.
movies.tagline: We all scream.

movies.title: Jazz an einem Sommerabend
movies.plot: Set at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival, this documentary mixes images of water and the town with performers and audience. The film progresses from day to night and from improvisational music to Gospel. It's a concert film that suggests peace and leisure, jazz at a particular time and place.
movies.tagline: ...love on a summer's night!

movies.title: Spaziergang nach Syrakus
movies.plot: In the middle of his life, Paul Gompitz from Rostock makes the decision to travel to Syracuse in Sicily. He is driven to follow in the footsteps of the poet Johann Gottlieb Seume. But: Paul lives in the GDR, behind the most annoying border in the world. His plan is impossible by legal means. So he has to prepare an escape.

movies.title: Sunny Dancer
movies.plot: Ivy is a teenager in remission from cancer, whose mum and dad insist she attend Children Run Free Camp, a summer retreat for young adults affected by cancer. However, as Ivy is reluctantly dragged through camp experience, she discovers new feelings with new friends.
movies.tagline: You'll wish you were there.

movies.title: The Love That Remains
movies.plot: Anna and Magnús are separating, working out how best to navigate breaking up without confusing their three children. Over the course of one year, life continues, in many ways, as normal, with each change of season occasioning little differences at home and in the surrounding landscape.

movies.title: We are here: Eyes without Gaze
sourceTitles: We are here: Eyes without Gaze

movies.title: Akira
movies.plot: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.
movies.tagline: Neo-Tokyo is about to E.X.P.L.O.D.E.

movies.title: Blue Velvet
movies.plot: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.
movies.tagline: It's a strange world, isn't it?

movies.title: Cabaret
movies.plot: Inside the Kit Kat Club of 1931 Berlin, starry-eyed singer Sally Bowles and an impish emcee sound the clarion call to decadent fun, while outside a certain political party grows into a brutal force.
movies.tagline: Life is a Cabaret.

movies.title: Das Kabinett des Dr. Caligari
movies.plot: A delirious young woman feels trapped in a remote mansion at the mercy of a madman.
movies.tagline: To The Unshockables: IT SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS, SHOCKS

movies.title: Der Himmel über Berlin
movies.plot: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.
movies.tagline: There are angels on the streets of Berlin.

movies.title: Do the Right Thing
movies.plot: Sal is the Italian owner of a pizzeria in Brooklyn. A neighborhood local, Buggin' Out, becomes upset when he sees that the pizzeria's Wall of Fame exhibits only Italian actors. Buggin' Out believes a pizzeria in a black neighborhood should showcase black actors, but Sal disagrees. The wall becomes a symbol of racism and hate to Buggin' Out and to other people in the neighborhood, and tensions rise.
movies.tagline: It's the hottest day of the summer. You can do nothing, you can do something, or you can...

movies.title: Ghost in the Shell

14:00.cinema: Babylon Mitte

movies.plot: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human saved from a terrible crash, then cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals.
movies.tagline: There's nothing sadder than a puppet without a ghost.

movies.title: Hamlet
movies.plot: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, returns home to find his father murdered and his mother now marrying the murderer... his uncle. Meanwhile, war is brewing.
movies.tagline: Something is rotten in the state of Denmark.

movies.title: Lost Highway
movies.plot: A tormented jazz musician finds himself lost in an enigmatic story involving murder, surveillance, gangsters, doppelgängers, and an impossible transformation inside a prison cell.
movies.tagline: A lost road on the edge of strange...

movies.title: Mulholland Drive - Straße der Finsternis
movies.plot: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.
movies.tagline: An actress longing to be a star. A woman searching for herself. Both worlds will collide... on Mulholland Drive.

movies.title: Paprika
movies.plot: Dr. Atsuko Chiba is a research psychologist who uses a device called the DC Mini to enter her patients' dreams, wherein she adopts the alter-ego "Paprika". When the device is stolen, she must stop rogue elements from merging the dream and waking worlds.
movies.tagline: This is your brain on anime.

movies.title: Twin Peaks - Der Film
movies.originalTitle: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
movies.plot: In the questionable town of Deer Meadow, Washington, FBI Agent Desmond inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the more cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.
movies.tmdbTitle: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me
movies.tagline: In a town like Twin Peaks, no one is innocent.

movies.title: The Black Garden
movies.plot: Samvel and Avo, Erik and Karen live in the land of a century-old conflict, rooted in the rubble of the Russian Empire. In Nagorno-Karabakh, people live, dream and prepare for a tragedy that is always on the horizon. Over 3 years, Alexis Pazoumian films the epilogue of the black garden, a land where war waits for no one.

movies.title: Dear You
movies.plot: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.
movies.tagline: Every letter leads home.

movies.title: Hard Boiled
movies.plot: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.
movies.tagline: As a cop, he has brains, brawn, and an instinct to kill.

movies.title: Shirkers
movies.plot: In 1992, teenager Sandi Tan shot Singapore's first indie road movie with her enigmatic American mentor Georges – who then vanished with all the footage. Twenty years later, the 16mm film is recovered, sending Tan, now a novelist in Los Angeles, on a personal odyssey in search of Georges' vanishing footprints.
movies.tagline: There are movers, there are shakers, and there are shirkers.

movies.title: Bär und die Puppe
movies.plot: A quiet cellist living in the countryside has his life disrupted when he accidentally bumps into a wealthy, temperamental woman in a Rolls-Royce. Angered by his indifference to her charm, she attempts to seduce him, but he resists her attempts to invade his peaceful life.
movies.tagline: Did you hear about "The Bear and the Doll?"

movies.title: Following
movies.plot: Bill, an idle, unemployed aspiring writer, walks the crowded streets of London following randomly chosen strangers, a seemingly innocent entertainment that becomes dangerous when he crosses paths with a mysterious character.
movies.tagline: You're never alone.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.plot: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

movies.title: Mit leiser Stimme
movies.plot: Back in Tunisia for her uncle's funeral, Lilia reunites with a family that knows nothing about her life in Paris, particularly her romantic life. Determined to uncover the mystery behind her uncle's sudden death, Lilia finds herself confronted with family secrets.

movies.title: Father Mother Sister Brother
movies.plot: Estranged siblings reunite after years apart, forced to confront unresolved tensions and reevaluate their strained relationships with their emotionally distant parents.

movies.title: Scherbenland
movies.plot: Spanning 50 years, the documentary traces a path through the Berlin district of Kreuzberg, linking the legacy of the rock band "Ton Steine Scherben" - best known for their work in the 1970s - with their successors.

movies.title: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf
sourceTitles: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf
movies.originalTitle: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf
movies.tmdbTitle: Albrecht Weinberg - Es ist immer in meinem Kopf

movies.title: Transit - Stories of Travellers and Migrants
movies.criticTitle: Transit - Stories of Travellers and Migrants
sourceTitles: Transit - Stories of Travellers and Migrants
movies.plot: In an attempt to flee Nazi-occupied France, Georg assumes the identity of a dead author but soon finds himself stuck in Marseilles, where he falls in love with Maria, a young woman searching for her missing husband.

movies.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
sourceTitles: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
OASIS: Don't Look Back In Anger
movies.originalTitle: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movies.plot: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.
movies.tmdbTitle: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movies.tagline: The great wait is over.

movies.title: The Secret Agent
movies.plot: Brazil, 1977. Marcelo, a technology expert in his early 40s, is on the run. Hoping to reunite with his son, he travels to Recife during Carnival but soon realizes that the city is not the safe haven he was expecting.
movies.tagline: Brazil 1977, a time of great mischief.

movies.title: Tally Brown, New York
movies.plot: Tally Brown, New York is a 1979 documentary film directed, written and produced by Rosa von Praunheim. The film is about the singing and acting career of Tally Brown, a classically trained opera and blues singer who was a star of underground films in New York City and a denizen of its underworld in the late 1960s.  In this documentary, Praunheim relies on extensive interviews with Brown, as she recounts her collaboration with Andy Warhol, Taylor Mead and others, as well as her friendships with Holly Woodlawn, and Divine. Brown opens the film with a cover of David Bowie’s “Heroes” and concludes with “Rock ’n’ Roll Suicide.” The film captures not only Tally Brown’s career but also a particular New York milieu in the 1970s.

movies.title: What We Can Know About Edmond and Basile
sourceTitles: What We Can Know About Edmond and Basile
movies.originalTitle: What We Can Know About Edmond and Basile
movies.plot: An exploration of Edmond Dédé and Basile Barès were 19th-century New Orleans composers of color. Dédé, born free, was an orchestral composer and violist, known for his opera Morgiane. Barès, born into slavery, was a pianist and composer of music for dance halls, unique for being the only known American composer with a copyright assigned to his work while enslaved.
movies.tmdbTitle: What We Can Know About Edmond and Basile

movies.title: Nonna
movies.plot: Rosa, alone in her house in southern Italy which she built herself. Her children and grandchildren still live in Germany. This is not the way she thought it would be. Must she let go of her legacy?

movies.title: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
movies.criticTitle: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
sourceTitles: Disunited Nations - Die UNO und der Nahe Osten
movies.plot: Francesca Albanese, the UN Special Rapporteur on human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories, had already labelled events in Gaza a genocide back in March 2024. Following her lead, this piece takes us deep into the heart of the institution’s crisis, as it struggles with its inability to stop the massacre of civilians.

movies.title: Steal This Story, Please!
movies.plot: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

movies.title: Fucking Different XXX
movies.plot: In Fucking Different XXX, the passion for explicit sex scenes brought eight international filmmakers together. The eight short films shot in Paris, Berlin and San Francisco are about intensive sex, quick sex, romantic sex, funny sex, the first sex, and the last sex. The range goes from a lesbian quickie in the toilet, a bloodthirsty orgy, romantic fisting all the way to wet teenage dreams. The result is a never seen before look upon sexual tastes and varieties, far from clichés, with a fresh and sometimes humorous approach.

movies.title: The Piano Tuner
movies.plot: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.
movies.tagline: Everybody has one hidden talent.

movies.title: Amore und Basta!
movies.plot: She hates men, he hates complications - but after one passionate night ties them together, these two irreconcilable opposites are forced to coexist... working at the same school, with a baby on the way! Can a staunch feminist and an oblivious chauvinist find common ground?

movies.title: Bouchra
movies.plot: Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression.
movies.tagline: "What's on your heart?"

movies.title: B-Movie: Lust & Sound in West-Berlin 1979-1989
movies.plot: The wild West Berlin of the 1980s became the creative melting pot of pop subcultures: music, art and chaos. Before the Iron Curtain fell, anything and everything seemed possible.
movies.tagline: If you can remember the 80's, you weren't there!

Breaking the rules of the vampire world, they choose love and run away, only to face the same cruel fate again and again. Even with danger closing in as sharp as a “Knife,” the words they say to comfort each other, “Big Girls Don't Cry,” lead them into a forbidden love called “CRIMINAL LOVE.” What ending awaits this love, sealed in blood?

movies.plot: On the last day of 1999, 20-year-old Sebastian locks himself in a TV studio. He has two hostages, a gun, and an important message for the world. The story of the attack explores a rebel’s extreme measures and last resort.

movies.title: Antarctica 3D - Narrated by Benedict Cumberbatch
movies.plot: Two Japanese scientists, Ushioda and Ochi, develop a bond with their sled dogs while on an expedition in Antarctica.
movies.tagline: Amidst the coldest, harshest surroundings on earth, this true story celebrates the mystery and the warmth of life.

movies.title: Birthright
movies.plot: When he learns of his mother’s death, Thomas returns to Brazil with Beni, his partner, and is told he now owns a country house that used to belong to a grandmother he never met. Curious to connect with his family history, they visit the house and Thomas is welcomed by two aunts that treat him like a long-lost child. As Thomas becomes increasingly enchanted with the place, Beni begins to suspect that something lurks beneath the façade of a quiet country life.
movies.tagline: Blood runs deep.

movies.title: Exhibition on Screen: Frida Kahlo
movies.plot: She was a prolific self-portraitist, using the canvas as a mirror through all stages of her turbulent and, at times, tragic life. This highly engaging film takes us on a journey through the life of one of the most prevalent female icons: Frida Kahlo. Displaying a treasure trove of colour and a feast of vibrancy on screen, this personal and intimate film offers privileged access to her works and highlights the source of her feverish creativity, her resilience and her unmatched lust for life, men, women, politics and her cultural heritage.
movies.tagline: The icon, the artist.

movies.title: Ghost School
movies.plot: Carola is a mischievous girl who doesn't care much for school- except for sports and recess, of course. Without her good friend Willi to keep her on the straight and narrow, she would really be in trouble. One day at school, Carola has an idea. She invents what she calls "International Ghosts' Day" and a ghost named "Buh" to go with it. When Buh turns out to be less-than-imaginary the two decide to switch places, with Buh taking on all the schoolwork, and Carola taking the opportunity to play practical jokes on all her friends...
